invocations.zig-wasm: zig build-exe -target wasm32-wasi -O ReleaseFast <case>.zig (no libc) → node (V8 wasm)

invocations.shermes: shermes -O <case>-flat.js -o <case>-shermes (Hermes VM linked as a shared library, counted in the size; Date.now clock, ms) → run binary
invocations.js2wasm: js2wasm <case>-flat.js --target node (JS-host WasmGC; wasm-opt where installed) → node (V8 wasm, its generated imports helper)
